meta.name: add-dashboard
meta.description: Add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw. Installs @nanoco/nanoclaw-dashboard and a pusher that sends periodic JSON snapshots.

copy.tagline: 添加 NanoClaw 监控仪表板，定期推送数据快照。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你管理 NanoClaw 并希望实时观测其状态。
copy.tagline_en: Add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw and stream periodic data snapshots.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage a NanoClaw instance and want to watch its metrics on a dashboard.

howto.what: 给 NanoClaw 装一个本地监控面板(默认端口 3100),展示 agent 分组、会话、渠道、用户、token 用量、上下文窗口、消息活动与实时日志;并加一个 pusher,每 60 秒推 JSON 快照、每 2 秒推日志给面板。
howto.when: 当你要求给 NanoClaw 添加监控面板(如 /add-dashboard),或想查看它的 agent 分组、会话等运行时状态时接管。未设 DASHBOARD_SECRET 时 pusher 不启动。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 加一个 dashboard 监控面板
say.note: 会装 npm 包并在 index.ts 里改一处

say.text: 把 dashboard 端口从 3100 改成 3200
say.note: 改 .env 的 DASHBOARD_PORT 后重启服务

say.text: 怎么确认 dashboard 已经跑起来了
say.note: 会给出 curl /api/status 等检查步骤

howto.what_en: Installs a local monitoring dashboard for NanoClaw (default port 3100) showing agent groups, sessions, channels, users, token usage, context windows, message activity and live logs, plus a pusher that posts JSON snapshots every 60s and logs every 2s.
howto.when_en: Use when you ask to add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw (e.g. /add-dashboard), or want to see its agent groups, sessions and other runtime state. The pusher no-ops without DASHBOARD_SECRET.

say_en.note: Installs the npm package and edits index.ts

say_en.text: Change the dashboard port from 3100 to 3200
How do I check the dashboard is running?
